scope: One locally authored AC1024 ASCII model-space POINT with selected sparse material, current-material and LAYER links, using an isolated LibreCAD application profile.
checks: The current consumer application opened the authored source, saved as DXF 2010 to a new path, and reopened that saved drawing; the application reported the save and displayed the RAWTEST layer.

ezdxf 1.4.5 independently checked the saved output after native reopen. It retains the material dictionary and owner, name and channel flag, current-material, LAYER and POINT references and POINT location (6, 7, 0), with zero audit errors or fixes.
The current application binary was linked to the scratch installed shared codec and built with an isolated settings organization; the temporary source change was restored after the build.
limits: No native point edit, 3D material rendering, other object graphs, producer or platform is qualified by this test. The input is locally authored; no drawing fixture is committed.
